_schema: team-channels v2 — maps team name to its alert channel(s) for notify-responsible-team
_shapes: a team maps to ONE channel object (v1, implicit slack) or an ARRAY of channel objects (v2)
_types: slack {channel, webhook_env} · msteams {channel, webhook_env} · pagerduty {routing_key_env} · opsgenie {api_key_env, region?: us|eu}
_secrets: config names the env var only — the secret itself lives in gitignored .env / .claude/settings.local.json, never here
_teams: team names must match the first segment of baselines/<team>.<profile>.json filenames
